Question: A makes \(x\) items per day, and B makes 2 more items per day than A. A takes the same amount of time to make 60 items as B takes to make 80 items. Find \(x\).
Solution: Set up the equation \(\frac{60}{x}=\frac{80}{x+2}\). Clearing the denominators gives \(60(x+2)=80x\), so \(x=6\). Checking confirms that it satisfies the conditions of the problem.
